regime._why: LQ-20261107-1511. MARKET_REGIME_CHANGE may fire only on a close the lane can call CURRENT: the newest source close must be no older than the last COMPLETED trading session (NYSE calendar), minus this lag in sessions. 0 = strictest. On 2026-11-09 the detector fired an urgent VIX_25 event from a VIXCLS close dated 2026-11-05, read on a Monday whose last completed session was 2026-11-06, while live VIX was ~24.1 — the FRED ingest had stopped on 2026-11-07 and the lane never checked. A regime crossing is a STATE, not a stop: refusing a stale close delays the alert to the next published close and never sends a false urgent one. A positive lag tolerates a publication delay at the cost of exactly that many sessions of blindness; widen only with the operator's word.
